title: SN Sexual Memories
tagline: Every OStim or SexLab scene becomes a memory for those who took part and for a bystander who saw it, NPCs talk about it, and a relationship map shows what lies between the people around you.
description:
**For adult players.** A SkyrimNet add-on for OStim Standalone or SexLab (P+ or 1.6x).

Every intimate scene is remembered and talked about, by SkyrimNet's AI, and the people around you have more to say.

**This mod keeps adding features that make your world livelier and chattier.** Each of them sends extra requests to your LLM. If things get too busy, or you are watching your LLM costs, turn features off in the MCM.

## Memories of the scene
When a scene ends, each character who took part, the player included, gets a first-person memory of it, stored as their own SkyrimNet memory. The AI first judges what the encounter was for each of them (loving, casual, paid, a duty, reluctant or forced) from what happened before and during it; sex is not taken as affection. The memory says who took part, where and when, what happened (the animations, the acts, who climaxed), what was said around it, and how they felt and how the others seemed to feel. NPCs then recall it in later conversations like anything else they lived through.

## A witness remembers too
One bystander who saw the scene, picked at random among the NPCs nearby with the scene in sight, gets a memory of whom they saw, doing what, and how they took it, true to their own character and their relationship with those involved. When nobody saw it, nobody gets a memory.

## Lines during scenes
Every so often an NPC in a running scene says a line about what is happening, written and voiced by SkyrimNet. In a forced or rough scene, the one it is done to never sounds willing. With OStimNet installed, the lines use its description of the scene.

## Complaints about a partner
Now and then an NPC near you who has a husband, wife or lover complains to you about them, only while that partner is too far away to overhear.

## Your character speaks up (off by default)
Now and then your character says something to an NPC nearby, drawing on what just happened, on your character's memories and on how the two of you stand. The NPC answers, and the line is shown as a subtitle.

## Relationship map
Press a key (Y by default) and choose yourself or an NPC nearby: SkyrimNet's AI writes what lies between them and up to ten people around you, from both sides' memories, their diaries and SkyrimNet's events, and only from those. Each person gets a card: what happened between them, how each feels about the other, the key events and their ties to the others. Maps are saved per save, and can be remade in English. Needs Magelight UI or Prisma UI; with Phantasm, faces are shown. Its AI model can be set apart in SkyrimNet's plugin settings (SNSexualMemories).

## Settings
An MCM turns each feature on or off and sets how often it happens, and how much the relationship map reads. The memories of the participants are always made, with an importance of at least 0.8.

## In the dashboard
The memories made by this mod show "[Sexual Memories]" or "[Sexual Memories / Witness]" after the emotion in the memory list.

## Requirements
SKSE64, Address Library, SkyrimNet with an AI model set up, OStim Standalone or SexLab, SkyUI and MCM Helper. Optional: OStimNet; Magelight UI or Prisma UI for the relationship map; Phantasm for its faces. It adds no prompt that replaces one of SkyrimNet's own.

## Known limits
Tested on Skyrim 1.6.1170 with SkyrimNet 1.2.0. The installer offers the settings menu in English or Japanese; the memories are written in the language your game's SkyrimNet uses.

changelog:
Changes since 0.2.1, the last version on the Hub.

**New**
- **Relationship map** (needs Magelight UI or Prisma UI). Press a key (Y by default) and choose yourself or an NPC nearby: SkyrimNet's AI writes what lies between them and up to ten people around you: what happened between them, in order, how each feels about the other, the key events, and how the others are tied to each other. It reads both sides' memories, their diaries and SkyrimNet's events, and writes only what those records say. Maps are saved per save; Refresh remakes one, and a button remakes it in English. With Phantasm installed, faces are shown.
- **Complaints about a partner.** Now and then an NPC near you who has a husband, wife or lover complains to you about them, only while that partner is too far away to overhear.
- **Your character speaks up** (off by default). Now and then your character says something to an NPC nearby, drawing on what just happened, on your character's memories and on how the two of you stand. It is voiced when SkyrimNet voices the player, shown as a subtitle, and the NPC answers.

**Changed**
- **Memories fit the kind of encounter.** The AI first judges what the encounter was for each person (loving, casual, paid, a duty, reluctant or forced) from what happened before and during it. Sex is no longer taken as affection.
- New MCM settings for each feature, so any of them can be turned off.
